title: Live stream: endpoint /mimid/live, version 1 messages, identifiers (INVENTED)
description:
Epic mimid-e64f; docs/design/binary-live-stream.md §5.1, §5.7, §5.11 and the CDDL there.

Chosen by the agent for mimid-e64f, unattended (INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC):
- Endpoint: WebSocket at <server>/mimid/live, where <server> is the agent's server_url with http turned into ws and https into wss. Not advertised in the JMAP Session, so a client of the stream never reads JMAP: the stream must stand on its own (the ProviderHello carries what the mimi capability says).
- Version 1 (v = 1). Message names (t) and member names as in the note's CDDL; the codec crate is mimid-live.
- Identifiers: a KeyPackage by its KeyPackageRef (exact bytes); a room by its room ID; a Message by messageId (the JMAP id); a Chat by chatId and a Consent record by consentId (the JMAP ids), because the draft defines no other name for them.
- SetChatAccepted and ListChats "accepted" restate decision mimid-1wgh.63's privateMetadata record; ListChats also gives "bound" (findings F4, F6).
- Changed (Chat, KeyPackage, Consent) is sent only after a Subscribe, computed as the EventSource computes StateChange.
- Times are uint milliseconds since the epoch, as protocol-07, not RFC 3339 text.
notes: 2026-11-21, Mark's change: a server with live_stream on also lists the stream in the JMAP Session's capabilities under the vendor capability tag:reviewcommit.com,2026:mimid:live (INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC; tag: URI under the authority of mimid's problem types; constant mimid_live::SESSION_CAPABILITY), value {"url": <ws/wss URL of /mimid/live built from base_url>}. Absent with the stream off; a request may name it in using only while listed. The stream still needs no JMAP: a client that knows server_url connects directly, and nothing after the hello reads JMAP. docs/design/binary-live-stream.md §5.1.
